_metadata.purpose: Multi-dimensional product segmentation for dynamic merchandising
_metadata.methodology: Based on ACTUAL Alpha Medical inventory analysis (96 products)

cold_pain_therapy_market.key_driver: Aging population + increased joint pain prevalence

demographic_segmentation.factual_analysis: Based on ACTUAL Alpha Medical inventory (78 products analyzed)
demographic_segmentation.office_workers_25_55: 28.2% of catalog (22 products) - posture, neck, back, ergonomics
demographic_segmentation.seniors_65plus: 26.9% of catalog (21 products) - arthritis, chronic pain, heated therapy
demographic_segmentation.beauty_wellness_25_55: 20.5% of catalog (16 products) - LED masks, anti-aging, skin rejuvenation (NON-orthopedic)
demographic_segmentation.athletes_18_45: 10.3% of catalog (8 products) - sports, performance, recovery
demographic_segmentation.gamers_16_35: 5.1% of catalog (4 products) - wrist/carpal tunnel (dual-purpose with office)
demographic_segmentation.specialized_medical: 3.8% of catalog (3 products) - stroke recovery, cerebral palsy rehab (adults), leg correctors
demographic_segmentation.kids_pediatric_REMOVED: Only 1-2 products (1.3-2.6%) - too small to segment
demographic_segmentation.note: Segmentation based on factual inventory, not generic market assumptions

seasonality_medical_facts.winter_impact: Barometric pressure drops expand joint tissues → increased arthritis pain + stiffness
seasonality_medical_facts.cold_circulation: Low temperatures reduce blood circulation → muscle spasms + discomfort
seasonality_medical_facts.summer_variations: Some patients: swelling in humid heat; Others: improvement in warmth
seasonality_medical_facts.spring_sports: Activity resumption → injury prevention demand surge

seasonality.rationale: Medical research confirms barometric pressure & temperature significantly affect musculoskeletal pain

demographics.rationale: FACTUAL Alpha Medical inventory: Office 28.2%, Seniors 26.9%, Beauty 20.5%, Athletes 10.3%, Gamers 5.1%, Medical 3.8%
demographics.methodology: Segmentation based on ACTUAL catalog analysis (78 products), not generic market research

office_workers_25_55: Lower back & lumbar support (disc herniation, pain relief)
seniors_65plus: Heated/magnetic therapy (Tourmaline knee pads, hot compress)
beauty_wellness_25_55: LED light therapy masks (SIGNIFICANT non-orthopedic - 20.5% = 16 products)
Face & neck skin rejuvenation (7-color photon therapy)
Eye massagers & facial devices (dark circles, fatigue relief)
Recovery & wellness (athletes use for recovery, women for anti-aging)
NOTE: Out of orthopedic scope but 2nd largest category
gamers_16_35: NOTE: Dual-purpose products also serve office workers
specialized_medical_rehabilitation: Cerebral palsy rehabilitation (ADULT patients, not pediatric)
Rehabilitation robot gloves (mirror training, hand function recovery)
